name: Purabi Satapathy/ ପୂରବୀ ଶତପଥି

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Purabi Satapathy is an Odia poet from Rasol, Dhenkanal. Her collection Raaga Purvee was published by Sahitya Akademi under its Navodaya scheme in 2021. Her work here brings the search for self-understanding into contact with love, mortality and the renewing life of the natural world.

‘ନବ ନିର୍ମାଣ’ finds an image of persistence in new growth rising from damaged ground. ‘ଅପତ୍ୟ ସ୍ନେହ’ gives tenderness the form of a blessing, while ‘ସେଲ୍ଫି’ moves through rooms of memory, sky and fields toward a final encounter with time. Across these poems, bodily feeling and imaginative transformation remain closely entwined.
